items.title: Enhanced Esophageal Cancer Detection Using Spectrum-Aided Vision Enhancer: A Comparative Study of White Light Imaging, Narrow-Band Imaging, and Algorithmic Narrow-Band Imaging-Like Imaging.
items.summary: Journal: DEN open. Abstract: BACKGROUND AND AIMS: Esophageal squamous cell carcinoma (ESCC) detection is crucial for improving survival. While narrow-band imaging (NBI) improves mucosal visualization, limitations remain. We evaluated the diagnostic performance of the Spectrum-Aided Vision Enhancer (SAVE), an algorithmic NBI-like technology reconstructed from white light imaging (WLI). METHODS: We conducted a retrospective, image-based exploratory feasibility study to descriptively evaluate the diagnostic performance of WLI, NBI, and SAVE. A dataset of 1350 still endoscopic images (450 each for WLI, NBI, and SAVE) across normal mucosa, dysplasia, and ESCC stages from 158 patients was blindly reviewed by three endoscopists with different experience levels (3, 5, and 15 years). Diagnostic metrics included sensitivity, specificity, accuracy, and reading time. RESULTS: For ESCC, SAVE demonstrated diagnostic performance metrics (sensitivity: 0.81-0.97, specificity: 0.85-0.96) that were numerically similar to WLI and NBI. For dysplasia detection, SAVE had lower observed sensitivity (0.39-0.62) compared to NBI (0.55-0.85) across all observers, representing a clinical limitation for precancerous screening in its current format. Mean per-image reading times were similar across WLI, NBI, and SAVE. CONCLUSIONS: In this retrospective study, SAVE showed diagnostic potential for ESCC, with observed diagnostic performance metrics numerically similar to those of WLI and NBI in this exploratory dataset, but lacked sensitivity for dysplasia. These findings are hypothesis-generating and warrant further prospective, multicenter validation to refine the algorithm for early cancer detection.
items.headline: 알고리즘 기반 내시경 영상기술, 식도암 조기진단 가능성 제시
items.brief: Spectrum-Aided Vision Enhancer(SAVE)라는 알고리즘적 NBI 유사 영상기술이 기존 백색광 영상(WLI) 및 협대역 영상(NBI)과 유사한 식도 편평세포암 진단 성능을 보였다. 다만 이형성증 조기진단 민감도는 낮아 추가 연구가 필요하다.
items.why: 식도암 조기진단에 영상 알고리즘의 임상적 가능성을 보여준다.
items.evidence_note: 후향적 연구, 진단 성능 평가 중심

items.title: Virtual Chromoendoscopy Enhancing Visualization of Parasite Anatomical Landmarks: A Case Report.
items.summary: Journal: DEN open. Abstract: Cestodes are parasitic flatworms transmitted through fecal-oral transmission. Some patients may present with nonspecific gastrointestinal symptoms. Endoscopic identification of intestinal helminths is uncommon and may pose a diagnostic challenge. We describe the endoscopic findings of intestinal cestodiasis and highlight the role of advanced endoscopic imaging techniques in its in vivo recognition. We report the case of a patient with no significant medical history who presented with recent-onset intermittent gastrointestinal symptoms, including abdominal distension and bloating. Laboratory tests and computed tomography enterography showed no abnormalities. Using magnification and virtual chromoendoscopy, detailed visualization of a parasite attached to the terminal ileal mucosa was achieved. Colonoscopy revealed a thin helminth adherent to the terminal ileal mucosa. Virtual chromoendoscopy enhanced visualization of characteristic anatomical structures. This case highlights the diagnostic value of advanced endoscopic imaging techniques and underscores their usefulness for recognizing uncommon intestinal infections during routine colonoscopy.
items.headline: 가상 염색 내시경으로 장내 기생충 해부학적 구조 상세 관찰 성공
items.brief: 가상 염색 내시경을 활용해 소장 말단 점막에 부착된 촌충의 해부학적 특징을 상세히 시각화했다. 이는 드문 장내 기생충 감염의 내시경 진단에 도움을 줄 수 있음을 시사한다.
items.why: 신경과학적 영상기법이 기생충 감염 진단에 응용될 수 있음을 보여준다.

items.title: Heterojunction nanozyme achieve highly efficient antibacterial by cuproptosis-like death and ferroptosis-like death.
items.summary: Journal: Bioactive materials. Abstract: Metal-ion-mediated lethal pathways offers a highly potent strategy for antibacterial treatments. However, relying on single-pathway mechanisms often fails to overwhelm bacterial antioxidant defenses, reducing antibacterial efficacy. This study designed a heterojunction nanozyme (Cu2O/Fe2O3) that induces ferroptosis-like death and copper-mediated metabolic toxicity exhibiting cuproptosis-like features, achieving highly effective antibacterial treatment. Computational chemistry analysis indicates that the Cu2O/Fe2O3 heterointerface establishes a built-in electric field through spontaneous interfacial electron transfer, thereby enhancing its peroxidase (POD)-like activity. Within the acidic bacterial microenvironment, Cu2O/Fe2O3 catalyzes the generation of large amounts of reactive oxygen species (ROS) and releases metal ions, inducing and amplifying ferroptosis-like death, which disrupts the function of ETC enzymes by attacking iron-sulfur clusters. Concurrently, copper ions disrupt the redox balance by depleting bacillithiol (BSH), indirectly increasing bacterial susceptibility and promoting ferroptosis-like death. Furthermore, the accumulation of copper ions triggers severe metabolic impairments that biochemically resemble the cuproptosis cascade, which disrupts key enzymes of the TCA cycle and impairs the synthesis of electron donors (NADH and FADH2), thereby cutting off the supply of substrates to ETC at the upstream stage. Overall, this study demonstrates that triggering bimetallic ion-mediated metabolic disruptions induces an energy crisis in bacteria, providing a reference for multimodal antibacterial strategies.
items.headline: 이종접합 나노자임, 구리·철 이온 이용해 강력한 항균 효과 달성
items.brief: Cu2O/Fe2O3 이종접합 나노자임이 구리 매개 대사독성과 페롭토시스 유사 사멸을 동시에 유도해 박테리아 에너지 위기를 초래, 다중 경로 항균 전략의 참조 모델을 제시했다.
items.why: 복합 금속 이온 기반 항균 메커니즘의 진보를 보여준다.

items.title: Aptamer-CRISPR/Cas as a tool in point-of-care testing of infectious diseases.
items.summary: Journal: Talanta. Abstract: Aptamers and the CRISPR/Cas system have become the cornerstones of target detections due to their numerous advantages. Aptamers enable direct recognition of non-nucleic acid targets, such as pathogens and antigens, while CRISPR/Cas system drives signal amplification and rapid detection. The combined aptamer-CRISPR/Cas system can overcome the limitations of traditional target detection by realizing field-deployable, highly sensitive, specific, versatile, and rapid assays. Given the increasing number of different aptamer-CRISPR/Cas systems developed recently, particularly for infectious diseases, we provide a comprehensive overview of these platforms designed for detecting significant viruses such as SARS-CoV-2, Monkeypox virus, Hepatitis B virus and bacteria that include Mycobacterium tuberculosis, Staphylococcus aureus and Salmonella. Current challenges that impede the deployment of aptamer-CRISPR/Cas for point-of-care pathogen detection were also mapped, including primary barriers such as clinical matrix effect and stability. Several strategies to mitigate these issues were also set forth, predominantly the integration of artificial intelligence and machine learning to accelerate the transition of aptamer-CRISPR/Cas system to the clinical translation and commercialization phase, paving the way towards widespread implementation in global health.
items.headline: 아프리카돼지열병 등 감염병 현장진단에 Aptamer-CRISPR/Cas 시스템 활용 전망
items.brief: Aptamer와 CRISPR/Cas 결합 시스템이 비핵산 표적 인식과 신속 증폭을 결합해 감염병 현장진단에 적합한 고감도·고특이성 검사법을 제공하며 AI·머신러닝 통합으로 임상 적용 가속화 가능성을 제시했다.
items.why: 신경과학적 도구로서 분자진단 기술 발전에 기여할 전망이다.

items.title: Local-Global Spherical Sliced Wasserstein Graph Kernel for Schizophrenia Identification.
items.summary: Journal: International journal of neural systems. Abstract: Accurate identification of schizophrenia (SZ) using functional connectivity (FC) is fundamentally challenged by the non-Euclidean geometry of neuroimaging data and information loss from arbitrary graph thresholding. To overcome these bottlenecks, this study proposes the local-global spherical sliced Wasserstein graph (LG-SSWG) kernel. By embedding FC profiles onto a hyperspherical manifold, the proposed framework utilizes geodesic optimal transport to construct a mathematically rigorous, positive-definite graph kernel. This threshold-free approach synergistically integrates macroscopic whole-brain topology and region-specific functional architectures. Evaluated on the public COBRE dataset, LG-SSWG achieves a superior 84% accuracy, significantly outperforming state-of-the-art baselines. Beyond predictive accuracy, the method exhibits strong clinical interpretability by identifying critical neuroanatomical biomarkers, particularly the left thalamus and right precuneus. Network analysis reveals pervasive functional hyperconnectivity within subcortical relays and cognitive networks in SZ patients. Notably, this hyperconnectivity correlates positively with PANSS positive symptom scores. Consequently, these altered thalamocortical and precuneus-anchored circuits indicate that SZ clinical symptoms may be closely associated with disrupted sensory gating and functional segregation. Ultimately, the LG-SSWG kernel provides a principled geometric learning tool that advances both the objective diagnosis and mechanistic understanding of schizophrenia.
items.headline: LG-SSWG 그래프 커널, 조현병 환자 뇌기능 연결성 분석에서 84% 정확도 달성
items.brief: 뇌기능 연결망을 초구면 매니폴드에 임베딩하고 지오데식 최적수송을 이용한 LG-SSWG 커널이 조현병 환자와 정상군을 효과적으로 구분하며 임상적 해석 가능성을 제공했다.
items.why: 뇌 연결망 분석에 기하학적 머신러닝 기법 적용의 진전을 보여준다.

items.title: Skin secretion of Andrias davidianus aqueous extract delays skin aging by suppressing the MAPK pathway.
items.summary: Journal: Genes & diseases. Abstract: Skin aging, a prominent manifestation of organismal senescence, is closely associated with the accumulation of endogenous reactive oxygen species (ROS). This study investigated the anti-skin-aging effects of skin secretion of Andrias davidianus (SSAD) using in vitro models of human skin fibroblast (HSF) senescence induced by d-galactose (D-Gal) or ultraviolet B (UVB) irradiation and an in vivo murine model of UVB-induced photoaging. Our findings demonstrate that in vitro, SSAD aqueous extract pretreatment not only mitigated D-Gal/UVB-induced cell death and senescence by enhancing HSF proliferation and migration but also effectively attenuated intracellular ROS overproduction and DNA damage, while upregulating key antioxidant enzymes, including GPX-1 and SOD-1. In vivo, SSAD ameliorated UVB-induced dermal thickening, capillary dilation, and collagen degradation, and upregulated P21 expression. Mechanistically, the anti-aging efficacy of SSAD appears to be mediated by a multi-targeted action that suppresses ROS generation, inhibits MAPK signaling pathway activation, and promotes antioxidant enzyme expression. In conclusion, SSAD emerges as a promising natural agent capable of mitigating skin aging by concurrently targeting oxidative stress and modulating the MAPK pathway.
items.headline: 안드리아스 다비디아누스 피부 분비물, MAPK 경로 억제로 피부 노화 지연 확인
items.brief: 피부 섬유아세포 및 UVB 유발 마우스 모델에서 SSAD 추출물이 ROS 생성 억제와 항산화 효소 발현 증가를 통해 피부 노화 지연 및 손상 완화 효과를 나타냈다.
items.why: 산화 스트레스와 신경생물학 경로 조절을 통한 노화 연구에 기여한다.
items.evidence_note: 세포 및 동물 모델 실험 결과
